settings.heading: The Challenge
settings.body: Joon Distribution sells a catalogue that buyers need to inspect closely before committing. A flat product grid gave wholesale customers no way to judge scale, finish, or detail, so the sales conversation kept moving off the site and into email threads.

settings.heading: What We Built
settings.body: We rebuilt the storefront on Shopify Plus and layered an immersive 3D commerce experience over the catalogue. Products are presented as interactive 3D models a buyer can rotate and inspect at real scale, running on a WebGL pipeline tuned to load progressively so the page stays fast on mobile.
